item.name: Sewer Key
item.prerequisite: Sewer lever puzzle and Cosmic Cash route
item.rewardEffect: Opens or preserves access to the hidden Sewer route and Cosmic Cash Vine progression
item.cardSummary: Sewer Key is the first hidden route checkpoint. It is tied to the underground Sewer, the colored lever sequence, and the Cosmic Cash Vine path.

item.name: UFO Key
item.prerequisite: Sewer progress and Good Samaritan route
item.rewardEffect: Unlocks alien or LemonX endgame access and appears to be required for Purity Fruit progression
item.cardSummary: UFO Key is the second hidden key. It appears after Sewer progression and is linked to helping the stranger or alien NPC for Good Samaritan.

item.name: Purity Fruit
item.prerequisite: 100+ Ascends, strong Evolution progress, secret-key progress, and endgame quest requirements
item.rewardEffect: Ultimate completion reward with a permanent bonus
item.cardSummary: Purity Fruit is the completion target for deep Sell Lemons progression. It should be treated as an endgame goal, not a normal fruit collectible.
